_note: Public scout cards (Stage 1, public-domain evidence). Every player is under 18: club signal capped at MONITOR, agent at DEVELOP FIRST, no valuation. Numeric grades are published only after Andrew approves them in the private tracker.

players.name: Ziyad Baha
facts: Two goals against Fiji in six minutes after the break, one from the penalty spot.
Playing his second U-17 World Cup in a row, a rare level of tournament experience at this age.
players.next: Follow him against China PR on 23 November and Spain on 26 November.
players.up: A goal or decisive moment against Spain.
players.down: No shot on target against Spain or China PR.

players.name: Ahmed Safwat
facts: Best player of the U-17 Gulf Cup in Qatar this autumn, with two assists in the 3-1 final win over the UAE.
Started in midfield against Greece and led a ten-man side for over an hour.
players.next: Watch him set the tempo against hosts Qatar on 22 November.
players.up: A goal or assist against Qatar or Panama.
players.down: Little influence on the ball in a must-win match.

players.name: Ziad Saudi
facts: Scored Egypt's goal against Greece from outside the box while Egypt played with ten men.
players.next: Follow his minutes and shots against Qatar and Panama.
players.up: A second goal or a start in the next match.
players.down: Limited minutes in the remaining group matches.

players.name: Diego Elias Pelembe
facts: Captain. Two goals at the U-17 AFCON.
Red Bull Bragantino have announced his signing, to start in Brazil in June 2027 when he turns 18.
Ran midfield in the 4-0 win over Denmark and hit the woodwork.
players.next: Watch how he controls midfield against Argentina on 22 November.
players.up: A goal or assist against Argentina or Australia.
players.down: Mozambique lose control of midfield against Argentina.

players.name: Alírio Cuna Júnior
facts: Two goals against Denmark: the first African player to score twice at this tournament.
Both goals came inside the box, the first from a counter-attack.
players.next: Follow his runs in behind against Argentina on 22 November.
players.up: A third goal, or a goal against Argentina.
players.down: No shots against stronger defences.

players.name: Khensane Machel
facts: Scored Africa's first goal of the tournament, four minutes into the 4-0 win over Denmark.
Started in midfield beside captain Diego Elias Pelembe.
players.next: Follow his arrival into the box against Argentina.
players.up: A second goal or assist in the group.
players.down: Fewer forward runs against Argentina's midfield.

players.down: Cameroon outnumbered in midfield against Mexico.

players.name: Dismas Athanasi
facts: Age 14: the youngest player in FIFA's squad lists for Qatar 2026.
Top scorer at the U-17 AFCON with three goals as Tanzania reached the final.
players.next: Watch his first World Cup minutes against Costa Rica on 21 November. At 14 his route runs through his family and federation for years yet.
players.up: A goal at this World Cup.
players.down: Few minutes off the bench.
